## What and why

<!-- The motivation, and the observable change in behaviour. The diff shows the what; use this for the why. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `task precommit` passes locally
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` (skip for a change users can't observe)
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (`README.md`, `EXAMPLES.md`, `kb/`, or `--help`)

<!--
Conventions live in CONTRIBUTING.md. Two worth remembering:
one logical change per PR, and CI must be green before review.
-->
